card.name: Just before the word liver
card.fires_on: The first letter piece of LIVER in all-caps warnings, and small linking words like "or", "the", "of" right before liver or hepatic terms. It anticipates that liver is the next word.

modes.label: Start of LIVER in capitals
modes.description: The opening letter of LIVER split off in all-caps boxed warning text.
modes.example: INITIATED ONLY IN INDIVIDUALS WITHOUT ACTIVE<< L>>IVER DISEASE AND WITH NORMAL BASE

modes.label: Linking word before hepatic
modes.description: A small word such as "or" or "the" right before liver or hepatic wording.
modes.example: Those at risk include patients with renal<< or>> hepatic impairment, or poor nutritional state

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict liver or hepatic as the next word.
card.plain: It lights up when the next word is likely to be liver, as in liver disease or liver injury warnings.
